title: 第23章：预言还是剧透？
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
“这些货，你从哪里弄到的？”大姑父声音嘶哑，完全不复之前的冷淡强硬。

    马超迎着他的目光笑了笑：“大姑父，我能告诉你的是，这些货不偷不抢，至于来源就不方便透露了。”

    “我懂我懂！”

    大姑父干笑两声，能弄到紧俏货的人必然大有来头，他深知其中的利弊，言多必失。

    但抛开这些，这绝对是暴利。

    因为紧俏货从来就不愁卖，想要紧俏货的人太多了，而唯一需要担心的是货不够卖。

    想到这些，大姑父询问，“小超，我不问你货的来路，你老实跟我说，如果我能搞定销售的话，你能保证货源吗？”

    “能！”

    马超点了点头，“大姑父，咱们是自家人，虚的话我就不说了，这些货，我按照市场价9成给你，至于你能卖多少钱我不问，赚多赚少是你的事。”

    “我只要这份钱。”

    大姑父听见这话眼睛都亮了，这哪里是合作，分明是送上门的稳赚生意！

    “小超，你放心，大姑父不会让你失望的。”

    “对了你吃饭了没有，我让你大姑去买只烧鸡回来，咱们吃点喝点，边吃边聊。”

    “对对对，我这就去买只烧鸡回来。”
content_en:
"Where did you get these goods?" The eldest uncle's voice was hoarse, no longer as cold and tough as before.

    Ma Chao met his gaze and smiled: "Uncle, what I can tell you is that these goods are not stolen or robbed. As for the source, it is inconvenient to disclose them."

    "I understand, I understand!"

    The eldest uncle laughed dryly. Anyone who can get in-demand goods must have a good background. He is well aware of the pros and cons, and he will be wrong if he talks too much.

    But aside from that, this is definitely a huge profit.

    Because there is no need to worry about selling the goods that are in short supply. There are too many people who want the goods that are in short supply, and the only thing they need to worry about is not enough selling.

    Thinking of this, the eldest uncle asked, "Xiaochao, I won't ask you where the goods come from. Tell me honestly, if I can handle the sales, can you guarantee the source of the goods?"

    "Yes!"

    Ma Chao nodded, "Uncle, we are our own family. I won't say anything false. I will give you these goods at 90% of the market price. As for how much you can sell them for, I don't care. It's your business to make more or less."

    "I just want this money."

    My eldest uncle's eyes lit up when he heard this. This was not a cooperation, it was clearly a profitable business delivered to his door!

    "Xiao Chao, don't worry, my eldest uncle will not let you down."

    "By the way, have you eaten? I asked your aunt to buy a roast chicken and come back. Let's eat and drink and chat while eating."

    "Yes, yes, I'm going to buy a roast chicken and come back."
